title: Read-only role cannot read the approval list: Runtime, approvals and governance pages fail for the viewer

documented_rule.text: DP-01–DP-04 | `operator` | Pool-scoped | Deployment plans and approvals
A 401/403 from an owner is `denied` ... (a tenant-scoped viewer who may not read approvals still gets the rest)
_approval_reader: roles must intersect WRITE_AUTHORITY_MATRIX roles | {approval_reader, approval_proposer, operator}, else 403 'Approval read role required' (line 1423)
dev-login viewer principal carries roles ('viewer',) only; approver (line 62) carries ('approver', 'governance_reviewer')
existing test pins that the Governance owner refuses the real dev-login viewer token with 403

redaction_finding.text: safe_redact_evidence_refs / redact_evidence_refs (line 817) redact by capability set from auth/policy.py::capabilities_for_identity (line 490, role map line 80); no role is admitted or refused by it, so the redaction on GET /bff/approvals is not evidence that viewer read is intended.

conflict_kept: The task summary read the BFF redaction as meaning viewer read is intended; the contract, the owner rule and an existing owner test say the viewer may not read approvals. The owner side is right; the BFF side was wrong only in passing the owner's 403 through untyped.

change.what: New _forward_read used by GET /bff/approvals, GET /bff/approvals/{id}, GET /bff/approvals/{id}/evidence and GET /bff/management/governance-ledger: an owner 403 becomes 403 {error.code: FORBIDDEN, i18nKey: errors.FORBIDDEN, details.precondition_failed: approval_read_role, details.permission_state: no_permission, details.surface: approvals, details.owner: governance} with no record content. Other owner statuses are unchanged. Decide and batch-decide keep _forward unchanged.
change.not_changed: Governance owner rule, BFF redaction, BFF role checks, every write path.

tests.setup: Real dev-login JWTs (viewer, operator, approver) from the BFF auth router; real Governance app (services.governance.main.app) verifying them with its own role rule; BFF governance router with production extract_identity, require_read_role, bff_error, redact_evidence_refs and capabilities_for_identity. Only persistence (JSON store in tmp_path) and the socket (urlopen routed to the Governance TestClient) are replaced.
cases: viewer GET /bff/approvals, /bff/approvals/{id}, /bff/approvals/{id}/evidence, /bff/management/governance-ledger -> typed 403 FORBIDDEN approval_read_role, one owner GET with the viewer's own token, no record ids in the body
Governance owner itself refuses the viewer token (403 'Approval read role required')

operator and approver: GET /bff/approvals lists only the pending decision, GET /bff/approvals/{id} returns it; evidence_refs redacted exactly as redact_evidence_refs with that principal's capabilities; redacted refs carry no note/storage_ref; redacted_evidence_count matches
approver sees the approval-decision ref the operator does not (capability difference preserved)

viewer POST /bff/approvals/{id}/decide -> 403 untyped owner pass-through (write path unchanged); batch-decide -> 207 with 1 failed (http_status 403); owner /review and /revoke refuse the viewer; stored decision unchanged

verification.command: .venv-pantheon/bin/python3 -m pytest -q tests/test_governance_router.py tests/test_bff_approvals_surface_contract.py tests/test_governance_owner_unconfigured_503.py tests/test_governance_evidence_redaction_sweep.py tests/test_project_approvals_regression.py tests/test_cited_evidence_list.py auth/test_dev_approver_governance.py governance/ (cwd services/control-plane/bff)

verification.result: 2-3 failures in human inbox / cockpit timing tests; the same tests fail on the base without this change (pre-existing, unrelated to approval reads)

residual_findings.finding: /management/runtimes, /management/approvals, /management/governance and /management/governance/ap_301 must render the typed FORBIDDEN approval_read_role answer as a no-permission state (or not request approvals for a viewer). Until then the viewer crawl still lists these pages, so the hosted acceptance item depends on that follow-up.

hosted_acceptance: pending: the next Dev release crawl no longer lists the four pages for a 403; requires the frontend residual. No VM or SSH access performed by this task.
